where: blaze why: steps recomputed for no recorded reason
what: In the oracle's two smoke runs and its alternation run the daemon's log said `blaze why has no recorded reason for steps this build recomputed, which is a bug in blaze` for 9 of 53 builds: each cold build (unexplained=8, 15), a release build (10), and edits: a comment with lines moved saved by rename (2), a signature change after an interrupted build (1), a trait impl with an override after a second checkout built (4), a macro_rules value with an indent (1 and 4), a source cfg flip (2).
cost: why answers that say nothing; the oracle's check (c) fails on them, so they hide other failures of the same revision until skipped
whys: a step can be recomputed without a miss recorded for it
prevention: the oracle holds it at zero (check alarms)
state: open, for the lane that owns serve/why
